name: motta-statusline
description: Two-line status line: where the session runs (and the worktree's repo), the branch with an icon and color for where it stands (its PR merged, closed, draft, failing, running or green; else changed, unpushed or in step), whether files changed, push state and the last commit, the branch's PR with CI, conflicts and review, model and effort, a context bar with the auto-compact point, rate-limit bars with a pace tick, files, ctx, 5h and 7d opening the Changes, Context and Usage panes of changes-drill, context-drill and usage-drill, a slot that cycles rate, cost, session and runway, tokens and the generation rate (tokens per second, live while a request streams). Below the prompt (always visible) or as a band above it.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: below: in the hint line under the prompt, visible while Claude works (terminal and desktop). above: a colored band above the prompt that the spinner replaces during a turn and other mods can take over.
